states.name: q
states.meaning: 3-bit modulo-7 up-counter value. It is observed to be loaded/held at 4 while a is high; when a has been low on consecutive posedges, it increments modulo 7.

states.name: prev_a
states.meaning: The value of a sampled at the previous posedge. It updates to the current a on each posedge and causes the first low sample after a high to hold instead of count.

rules.condition: a == 1 at posedge => q <= 4 (load/hold q at 4; the first sampled posedge changes x to 4).
a == 0 && prev_a == 1 at posedge => q <= q (first low sample after high does not increment).
a == 0 && prev_a == 0 at posedge => q <= (q + 1) mod 7 (increment modulo 7).

mid: No mid-cycle input changes are indicated in the waveform.

uncertain.note: Waveform only shows a=1 with q already 4 after the first posedge; loading to 4 is inferred, but it could be an initial value followed by a hold.
candidates: a=1 synchronously loads q with 4 on every posedge
q is initialized to 4 on the first posedge and then held while a=1

uncertain.note: The first posedge after a falls low leaves q unchanged; the cause could be a one-cycle enable delay or a registered version of a.
candidates: q increments only after a has been low for two consecutive sampled posedges
a low condition is synchronized before enabling the counter
q is one register stage behind an a-enabled modulo-7 counter

uncertain.note: The observed sequence 4,5,6,0,1 under a=0 indicates counting, but the full wrap range and exact enable are inferred from a short waveform; the next value after 1 is not observed.
candidates: q is a modulo-7 up counter enabled by delayed ~a
q is a modulo-7 up counter enabled when prev_a=0
q counts 0..6 and wraps from 6 to 0 when a remains low
q cycles through 4,5,6,0,1 and wraps from 1 back to 4 when a remains low
